Our Story

Straight To The People Who Do The Work.

We are a family run engineering firm in Hamilton, going since 2006. Between us the team has over 100 years on the tools, and that experience goes into every part that leaves here.

When you call, you speak to the people who will actually make your parts. No being passed around. That is why our tolerances hold and our lead times are honest, because the person quoting you is the person cutting metal.

Our parts go into aerospace, defence, oil and gas and medical work, jobs where a part failing is not an option. So we check everything against your drawing before it ships.

Sister Company

Marpet Fabrications

Need heavier fabrication or specialist welding? Our sister company Marpet handles MIG, TIG and laser welding plus conveyor systems. Same standards, same family.

Capabilities

Everything You NeedMade, Under One Roof.

Six things we do well, all in one workshop. Whatever you need made, it gets checked against your drawing before it goes out the door.

SVC / 01 — Fabrication

Metal Fabrication

Brackets, frames, enclosures, conveyor systems and one off assemblies. Mild steel, stainless or aluminium, welded and finished to your drawing.

MIGTIGLaserMild SteelStainlessAluminium
SVC / 02 — Milling

CNC Milling

Pockets, profiles, contours, the awkward stuff. Whether you need one prototype or a full batch, it comes out to tolerance.

1200×750 Bed±0.01mm5 Axis
SVC / 03 — Turning

CNC Turning

Shafts, flanges, bushes and fittings. We turn up to 1 metre across and 3 metres long, or up to 5 metres for slimmer parts under 160mm.

Ø1m Max3m Length5m Under Ø160
SVC / 04 — Machining

CNC Machining

A 1200 by 750mm bed and 5 axis capability for the complicated jobs. We hold ±0.01mm across pretty much any material you throw at us.

PrototypeProductionAll Materials
